events.title: Zhao Kuangyin founds the Song dynasty
events.description: Proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao, the general became Emperor Taizu of Song. The dynasty reunited most of China and presided over remarkable advances in commerce, printing and technology.
events.html: Proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao, the general became Emperor Taizu of Song. The dynasty reunited most of China and presided over remarkable advances in commerce, printing and technology.

events.title: Electors unanimously choose George Washington as President
events.description: Presidential electors cast their votes and every one named George Washington. He remains the only President to win every electoral vote, which he did again in 1792.
events.html: Presidential electors cast their votes and every one named George Washington. He remains the only President to win every electoral vote, which he did again in 1792.

events.title: French National Convention abolishes slavery
events.description: Inspired by the slave revolt in Saint-Domingue, the Convention abolished slavery in all French colonies. Napoleon restored it in 1802, and France did not abolish it finally until 1848.
events.html: Inspired by the slave revolt in Saint-Domingue, the Convention abolished slavery in all French colonies. Napoleon restored it in 1802, and France did not abolish it finally until 1848.

events.title: John Marshall becomes Chief Justice of the United States
events.description: Marshall began 34 years as Chief Justice, the longest in the Court's history. His rulings, beginning with Marbury v. Madison, established judicial review and a strong federal government.
events.html: Marshall began 34 years as Chief Justice, the longest in the Court's history. His rulings, beginning with Marbury v. Madison, established judicial review and a strong federal government.

events.title: Seceded states meet at Montgomery to form the Confederacy
events.description: Delegates from six seceded states opened a convention in Montgomery, Alabama. Within days they adopted a provisional constitution and chose Jefferson Davis as provisional President.
events.html: Delegates from six seceded states opened a convention in Montgomery, Alabama. Within days they adopted a provisional constitution and chose Jefferson Davis as provisional President.

events.title: Philippine-American War breaks out in Manila
events.description: Shots exchanged between American and Filipino troops sparked war between the United States and the Philippine Republic. Officially ended in 1902, the conflict killed some 200,000 or more Filipino civilians.
events.html: Shots exchanged between American and Filipino troops sparked war between the United States and the Philippine Republic. Officially ended in 1902, the conflict killed some 200,000 or more Filipino civilians.

events.title: Hitler takes personal command of the German armed forces
events.description: After forcing out War Minister Blomberg and army chief Fritsch on trumped-up charges, Hitler abolished the War Ministry and assumed direct command. Ribbentrop became Foreign Minister the same day.
events.html: After forcing out War Minister Blomberg and army chief Fritsch on trumped-up charges, Hitler abolished the War Ministry and assumed direct command. Ribbentrop became Foreign Minister the same day.

events.title: Yalta Conference opens in Crimea
events.description: Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin met at the Livadia Palace to plan the end of the war. They agreed on the occupation of Germany, elections in Poland, Soviet entry into the Pacific war and the United Nations.
events.html: Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin met at the Livadia Palace to plan the end of the war. They agreed on the occupation of Germany, elections in Poland, Soviet entry into the Pacific war and the United Nations.

events.title: Ceylon becomes independent from Britain
events.description: Ceylon became a self-governing dominion in the Commonwealth, ending about 150 years of British rule. It became a republic and took the name Sri Lanka in 1972.
events.html: Ceylon became a self-governing dominion in the Commonwealth, ending about 150 years of British rule. It became a republic and took the name Sri Lanka in 1972.

events.title: Mark Zuckerberg launches 'TheFacebook' at Harvard
events.description: The Harvard student launched a social network for fellow students. Opened to the public in 2006, Facebook grew to billions of users and transformed how people share news and personal life.
events.html: The Harvard student launched a social network for fellow students. Opened to the public in 2006, Facebook grew to billions of users and transformed how people share news and personal life.
